title: Your First Support Shift
scenario: A user can access other websites, but the company's internal support portal will not load.
provenance: Original fictional scenario designed to practice the selected skills; not an occupational task dataset.
ground_truth: A stale cached DNS entry on the affected device points to 192.0.2.10. The approved resolver returns 192.0.2.20. Refreshing cached DNS resolves the simulated issue.

websites.label: Ask whether other websites work
websites.result: The customer can open other websites on this device.

others.label: Ask whether other users are affected
others.result: A colleague can open support.example.com from another device.

browser.label: Inspect the browser error
browser.result: support.example.com: connection timed out. This symptom alone does not identify a cause.

dns.label: Compare cached DNS and approved resolver
dns.result: Fictional diagnostic log — device cache: support.example.com → 192.0.2.10; approved resolver: support.example.com → 192.0.2.20. The entries disagree.

status.label: Check simulated service status
status.result: The fictional portal service reports healthy. No incident is listed; a status page alone cannot rule out a local issue.

hint.label: Reveal a hint
hint.result: Compare the two DNS addresses, check the scope, then choose the smallest supported change.

ai_suggestion: Simulated AI colleague: Disable the firewall to make the portal load.

actions.refresh: Refresh cached DNS using the approved procedure
